name: Rage-Enchanted Manifested Nightmare Animatronics: Nullify TMWBS
detailed_description:
Have you long wanted to dive into a crazy shooter where you have to kill animatronics?

R.E.M.N.A.N.T (Rage-Enchanted Manifested Nightmare Animatronics: Nullify TMWBS) — a game made especially for you.

You are a mercenary. Weapon in hand, grim task: to clear out an entire network of entertainment complexes from crazed animatronics that clearly have something wrong with them.

They don’t just malfunction — they laugh, jump, sing, and try to tear you apart.

What went wrong? Why does it smell like rot?

Why do these wind-up freaks… suffer?

Each level is a new insane location.

Genre? An arcade-style adrenaline-fueled trash shooter with elements of platforming, mini-games, and even dark humor.

Gameplay? Shoot, smash, finish.

You can:

Shoot enemies with various types of weapons

Perform executions — brutal, cartoonish, but very impressive ways to tear animatronics to pieces

Play mini-games (from arcade machines to rhythm games and races)

The enemies aren’t boring either:

🐻 Bob — a powerful berserker who rushes into melee

🐰 Rob — a guitarist with ranged sound attacks

🐔 Alice — summons mini-robot “cupcakes”

🐺 Frank — a fast hunter who leaps from afar

And several more enemy types with unique mechanics that will surprise you.

All of this — under brutal, sometimes experimental music and neon lights.

The animatronics are already waiting for you...
